title: Taking on Fats Domino and booking two weeks of dates
summary: Given Domino in January, Thomas books him for two-week runs of Mondays through Thursdays in short jumps.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: But then I... Let me tell you the story of how I got involved with Domino. That was my next big artist.
Yeah. They gave me Fats Domino January the 2nd. I had just started at the agency.

Oh, it was the late Fifties or early Sixties. I had heard about him, but I didn't know how good he was. I got so mad that I didn't send out nobody. Because here I got this big artist, and they tell me he's good, he's doing so much business. So I got the idea to hear that ...(?)... I had been thinking about that before that. See, I... Your big dates... A guy that come in your territory, as long as you could book him Friday, Saturday and Sunday, you had enough money made for him, for him to pay his band for the

week. But I got the idea of making more money. I said, "What if I can get me..." See, I had a guy for two weeks. So I said, "What if I can get me two Mondays, two Tuesdays, Wednesdays, two Thursdays..." I got all the Fridays and Saturdays... I only had two Sundays, but I got all the Fridays and Saturdays I want.

So this idea came to me. I called the guy and said, "I got a date on Fats Domino on January the 2nd." He said, "Send me a contract." And see, I called a guy that couldn't always get a date on Domino, on a place(?) when you know he'll make his money. That was so easy, i said, "Damn, I'll call..." I called another guy, and said, "I got a date on Fats Domino January 3rd." He said, "Send me a contract." I sent him a contract. See, I'd been booking a lot of these places...

Oh, the miles were close. 150-200 miles. And I had been booking a lot of them clubs and things. Because there was a jam(?) of little clubs in that Philadelphia area and the Virginia area where they couldn't get a date on Domino. Because he only had about six or seven dates I could get in two weeks if I was playing the Friday, Saturday and Sunday. So I figured out my first Sunday I'd book him in Washington. And I had him
automatically Friday and Saturday, so I called the guy up in Boston; I called a guy that had a hard time getting Domino on a Friday -- I gave him a date on Domino.
